title: Halloween Gambit
author: LlamaChess Repertoire
description: If you want an obscure aggressive opening Black often doesn't know — the Halloween Gambit (4.Nxe5) sacrifices a knight for a crushing pawn center.

lessons.title: Main Line — Knight Sac on e5
lessons.subtitle: Line #1 · 4.Nxe5 core

steps.title: Main Line — Knight Sac on e5
steps.theory: Sacrifice the knight on e5. If Black takes it back wrong, your pawn center wins the game.
